title: BenchBench-Cloning: Evaluating Molecular Cloning Design and Protocol Development
abstract: arXiv:2610.33355v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Molecular cloning is one of the most routine wet-lab workflows, yet existing evaluations of language models in biology mostly test knowledge recall or isolated steps rather than end-to-end experimental planning. We introduce BenchBench-Cloning, a benchmark for large language models comprising 65 molecular cloning tasks grounded in sequence records, laboratory notebooks, and published experimental studies. Planning a molecular cloning experiment requires defining a set of constructs needed for a scientific objective and a construction route to produce them. BenchBench-Cloning contains 50 protocol-development tasks, in which agents produce an executable protocol for a specified construct, and 15 construct-design tasks, in which agents determine the constructs a scientific objective calls for. translated_title: BenchBench-Cloning：评估分子克隆设计与实验方案开发
translated_abstract: 分子克隆是最常规的湿实验室工作流程之一，然而现有对生物学领域语言模型的评估大多只测试知识回忆或孤立步骤，而非端到端的实验规划能力。我们提出了BenchBench-Cloning，一个面向大语言模型的基准测试，包含65个分子克隆任务，这些任务基于序列记录、实验室笔记本和已发表的实验研究。规划一个分子克隆实验需要定义实现科学目标所需的一组构建体（constructs）以及产生这些构建体的构建路线。BenchBench-Cloning包含50个方案开发任务（智能体需要为指定构建体生成可执行的实验方案）和15个构建体设计任务（智能体需要确定科学目标所要求的构建体）。方案开发任务通过在克隆模拟器中执行来评估；构建体设计任务则通过特定任务的确定性检查来评估。
tldr: 提出了首个端到端评估大语言模型分子克隆实验规划能力的基准BenchBench-Cloning，包含65个基于真实实验记录的构建体设计与方案开发任务，并借助克隆模拟器执行和确定性检查实现自动化评估。
en_tdlr: Introduces BenchBench-Cloning, the first benchmark for end-to-end evaluation of LLMs' molecular cloning experimental planning, comprising 65 construct-design and protocol-development tasks grounded in real sequence records and lab notebooks, with automated evaluation via a cloning simulator and deterministic checks.
